subject: RE: Encord - Invoicing eProcurement System
text:
Hi Will,

There are a few different tracks we can take on invoicing and would like your input as well as yours @Thompson, Kaylene D<mailto:kaylene_thompson@uhg.com> and @Sara Cassidy<mailto:sara.cassidy@uhc.com>.

  1.  You can send the invoice directly to Sara and/or Kaylene and they can then process through our invoicing system, Concur. This is the most time-efficient option.
  2.  If you require a PO, we can create a PO and you can invoice against that.
  3.  Longer term solution is our Invoicing Against Contract which takes a few weeks to get into place. I might recommend this for the future if you’re interested. You’d need to be Ariba Enabled, but once you have it you would receive a code in which you’d invoice against moving forward.

For the first invoice, in the interest of time, I recommend option 1. This can also be the case for all following invoices as well. The invoice goes directly to the business partner and they upload it into our payment system. No PO required.

If you’d like to go with Option 1, please let email the invoice to them asap and they will upload.

Thank you and apologies for the delay.

know these by Tuesday so the chefs have enough time to prepare.

subject: Re: Encord Annotation Persona Requirements
text:
Hi Will,

We are working through some work plan organization on our end and things a little fuzzy for me in a few spots and I could use your direction/council to get our house in order to keep schedule.

Projects

  1.
What constitutes a project within Encord? Are they guidelines, workflows, etc?
  2.
If the workflow for Annotator and Auditor are different, are those different projects or just different setups?

The reason this is impactful is if Encord is building 1 project and we need more to meet current state of the business processes, then we need to plan engineering resources to build on our side.

Training

  1.
What does your typical training look like?
  2.
Would you be on-site to support any defect resolution as we work through that testing?

We are thinking we approach it as UAT training into UAT testing. From that we get to a full go-live decision.

I am sure there will be more but some clarity here could really help us!

Thanks,
Kaylene
